name: Four Points by Sheraton Jakarta, Thamrin
short_description: A 164-room select-service Four Points on Jalan M.H. Thamrin in central Jakarta, near Sarinah, Plaza Indonesia and Grand Indonesia. Opened 2016; all-day dining, a craft-beer lounge and 24-hour gym, but no pool.
ai_summary: Four Points by Sheraton Jakarta, Thamrin is a 164-room select-service hotel that opened in August 2016 on the main Jalan M.H. Thamrin artery in central Jakarta. Independent bloggers and guest reviews consistently rate its location as the standout: a 3-5 minute walk to Grand Indonesia and Plaza Indonesia, opposite Sarinah, near the Sabang culinary street, with a TransJakarta stop out front. It carries roughly a 4/5 score on TripAdvisor. Rooms are described as clean, modern and comfortable with plush Four Comfort beds, city views, work desks and free WiFi, though there is no bathtub. Dining centers on The Eatery (all-day international buffet, praised for varied Asian and Western breakfast) and the Best Brews lounge for local craft beers, plus a 24-hour Life Fitness gym. Service earns warm praise for friendly, attentive staff. The most common complaints are traffic noise from Thamrin-facing rooms (soundproofing is thin; earplugs or rear rooms help), occasionally unstable WiFi, and the absence of a swimming pool, which makes it better suited to business travelers than families. Overall it reads as dependable, well-located value in the city core.

faqs.question: Does Four Points by Sheraton Jakarta, Thamrin have a swimming pool?
faqs.answer: No. The hotel has a 24-hour gym with Life Fitness equipment but no swimming pool, which several guests note makes it better suited to business travelers than families.

faqs.question: How far is the hotel from Soekarno-Hatta International Airport (CGK)?
faqs.answer: It is approximately 36 km from Soekarno-Hatta International Airport (CGK), typically an hour or more by car depending on Jakarta traffic.

faqs.question: What is there to do near the hotel?
faqs.answer: It sits on Jalan M.H. Thamrin within a few minutes' walk of Grand Indonesia and Plaza Indonesia malls, Sarinah, and the Sabang culinary street, with a TransJakarta bus stop directly in front.

reviews.title: Staycation at Four Points by Sheraton, Thamrin, Jakarta.
reviews.author: FoodVenturer
reviews.summary: One-night Deluxe King stay praises the central location near Plaza and Grand Indonesia, clean bathroom, heavenly bed, a better-than-expected Asian/Western breakfast, and the Best Brews lounge. Notes no pool and Thamrin traffic noise.

reviews.title: Four Point By Sheraton, Low Budget Hotel Yang Rekomendasi Di Thamrin Jakarta
reviews.author: Maya Rumi
reviews.summary: Family staycation in a spacious, clean room with big-window city views and helpful staff. Room-service breakfast satisfied and free parking is a plus, but no bathtub or pool; rated budget-friendly and better for business than family.
